description: Checks PDF documents for accessibility: PDF/UA-1 (veraPDF) mapped to WCAG 2.2, plus colour contrast. Takes one PDF or a folder (up to 10 PDFs, e.g. public/docs). Returns a 0-100 score per file, the failing WCAG success criteria, the most severe issues, and what an automatic repair would fix. Unlike check_accessibility, this does NOT run locally: the PDF is uploaded to AccessLumens (api.accesslumens.com) for the check. The files are not stored; the findings are, and can include short text excerpts. Ask the user before uploading confidential documents. Takes about 20 seconds to a few minutes. Up to 10 MB and 300 pages per file.

file.description: A local PDF (./public/brochure.pdf), a folder to search for PDFs (./public), or a PDF's http(s) URL, which is downloaded on this machine first.

name: check_pdf
title: Check a PDF's accessibility
